budget.why: Even this weekend -> $5.00 available across 2 slots.

angles: London (PHI @ JAX, 9:30 AM ET) is left off: it kicks off less than 60 minutes after this run. A quick check before kickoff found nothing there priced better than the sharp books (Eagles ML +300 vs a fair 23.5% was closest, -1.5%).

Every DraftKings main line (moneyline, spread, total) on the 1 PM, 4 PM and Sunday-night games is at or worse than the sharp fair price. Closest: Steelers ML -148 vs fair 59.0% (-0.3%), Seahawks ML -166 vs 61.7% (-0.7%).
Props: about 800 DK player props were compared with Pinnacle at the same number, and about 590 of those with Kalshi too. One clears +2% on both: Croskey-Merritt under 13.5 carries.

Tee Higgins anytime TD (DK +130 vs Pinnacle 49%) and Rico Dowdle anytime TD (DK +215 vs Pinnacle 36%) look big on Pinnacle alone, but Kalshi has no market to confirm either. With only one source they stay off the card (rule 8).

Croskey-Merritt (groin) was limited in practice Wednesday and Thursday; RotoWire then reported him cleared to play. Austin Ekeler is back in Washington's backfield, and Hogs Haven/Yahoo note his role fading. All of that points to fewer carries, not more.
Winless teams (0-4): Titans, Texans (they play each other), Dolphins, Chargers. No 0-2 teams this week.
Fun Parlay: two volume-catch legs, both priced about fair against Pinnacle and Kalshi. It's for fun, so it gets $0.25, half the $0.50 allowed.

easy_bet.plain_summary: Bet Croskey-Merritt to get 13 or fewer carries. DraftKings prices it close to a coin flip, but the sharp books have the under winning a bit more often. He's coming off a groin injury and Ekeler is back to share the work.
easy_bet.reason_summary: Under 13.5 carries at DK -106 (51.5%) vs sharp fair 54.2% -> about +2.7%.
easy_bet.reason: Pinnacle hangs the same 13.5 with the Under at -130 / Over +107, which de-vigs to 53.9% Under. Kalshi's '14+ carries' market sits at 45.5c, so the Under is 54.5%. Average 54.2%, and the two sources are 0.6 points apart. DK -106 implies 51.5%, so the edge is about +2.7%. Context: limited practice all week with a groin strain (Rotoballer, FantasySP), then cleared to play (RotoWire via STACKED). Ekeler's return threatens his share (FantasyPros/Yahoo). Risk: Washington is a 3.5-pt home favorite, and a lead means more runs late. That's why this is tagged 'WSH trailing', and the Fun Parlay stays out of this game.

fun_parlay.reason: Two catch-volume legs, each about 59% by both Pinnacle and Kalshi, in games away from the Value Bet (no game-script conflict). Both are priced within 1% of fair at DK, so this is fun money, not value. Sized at $0.25 of the $0.50 allowed; the other $0.25 stays unbet.
